name: Filebase IPFS Pinning Service API
description:
Pin existing IPFS content in a Filebase IPFS bucket. Use a bucket-specific Bearer token generated in the Filebase console. A paid account is required. Create and replacement responses describe asynchronous work: poll the returned requestid until status is pinned or failed, keeping the source content reachable. A requestid is an opaque identifier, not a CID or UUID. IPFS content is public to anyone who has its CID; deleting a pin does not delete copies retained by other peers.

This Filebase-specific contract adapts the official IPFS Pinning Service API specification. Filebase differs in listing defaults, duplicate handling, and replacement behavior. For file uploads, CAR import, IPNS, S3 storage, and gateway management, consult the documentation and llms.txt; those interfaces are outside this specification.
